steps.name: Validate frozen workload and paired runner matrix
Record every planned trial before runtime preparation
Restore frozen Substrate and Dynamo sources
Record successful wheel build and native test jobs
Verify wheel provenance and install locked CPU runtime
Observe cache reselection and native affinity on two Mockers
Prepare Kind, gVisor MEMORY, durable storage and two Workers
Issue bounded access for five serial policies and cleanup
Release port forwards and Kind cluster
Record current run and actual job identifiers
Stage this runner's public raw evidence

null_field_semantics.completed_request_observation_missing: No valid completed request supplies this timing measurement; interactive TTFT additionally requires an interactive request.
null_field_semantics.resource_coverage_insufficient: Resource coverage is absent or outside [0.9, 1]; the reservation integral is unavailable.
null_field_semantics.resource_integral_invalid_or_missing: The source provides no finite nonnegative resource integral.
null_field_semantics.accounted_prompt_observation_missing: No completed request has valid engine cache accounting with a positive prompt-token denominator.
null_field_semantics.completed_first_round_wait_missing: No valid completed first-round request supplies all wait components required by this metric.
null_field_semantics.complete_trajectory_observation_missing: No complete uncensored trajectory supplies JCT; partially completed trajectories may supply censored_lower_bound_seconds.
null_field_semantics.trajectory_elapsed_observation_missing: Arrival and completion timestamps supply no finite nonnegative elapsed time for a partial trajectory.
null_field_semantics.registered_seed_units_incomplete: Mean and worst require every registered seed unit to supply a finite measurement; observed_mean and observed_worst retain available seed measurements.
null_field_semantics.observed_seed_units_missing: No observed seed unit supplies a finite measurement.
null_field_semantics.exploratory_seed_units_insufficient: The exploratory bootstrap interval requires at least two finite observed seed measurements.
null_field_semantics.trial_execution_evidence_missing: The planned trial has no unambiguous execution report in this run and attempt.
null_field_semantics.trial_measurement_records_missing: GitHub job logs confirm trial execution while request-level result records are unavailable; actual completed and failed/unoffered counts remain unknown.
null_field_semantics.usable_paired_measurement_missing: A difference requires both completed trials, verified five-policy pairing and finite measurements on both sides.
null_field_semantics.source_metadata_not_provided: An optional metadata field is absent from its original source; the archived source record retains its original value.
null_field_semantics.native_kv_delta_observation_missing: No deduplicated native KV diagnostic supplies a finite delta_ms.

null_field_rules.trials[].metrics: See the matching metric_availability null_reason and its observed_units.
null_field_rules.policy_groups[].metrics / by_source[].me: See each metric's planned_seed_units, observed_seed_units and null_reasons.
null_field_rules.paired_comparisons[].differences / by_so: See each metric's seed-unit counts and null_reasons.
null_field_rules.trials[].trajectories[].censored_lower_b: Complete trajectories report jct_seconds; partial trajectories require elapsed timestamps, otherwise trajectory_elapsed_observation_missing.
null_field_rules.artifacts[] / audit[] / trials[] optiona: source_metadata_not_provided; launch evidence additionally records source_execution_status and planned_source_commit.
